fable.w: The section is only a list of dollar amounts authorized or appropriated for Air Force installations in Alaska. It contains no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government, and there is no tempting contrary reading because nothing in the text is procedural.

qwen_block.w: This section lists specific dollar amounts appropriated for various Air Force bases and airports. It is a standard appropriations provision that allocates funds for construction or maintenance. It does not contain any language requiring consultation, public comment, advisory committees, or coordination with outside parties before the funds are used or decisions are made.

It has no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with states or tribes, rulemaking, or right to sue. qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that listing specific locations implies a decision-making process involving local stakeholders or public input. However, the text is merely a list of appropriations for specific military bases and airports. There is no mention of consultation, hearings, advisory boards, or any interaction with outside parties. The actors involved are implicitly the federal government (appropriating funds) and the locations themselves.
